== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Reached 3000 assists in the LCK on March 31st, 2024.
** Was the 16th player to reach 3000 assists in the LCK.
* Reached 4000 assists in the LCK on August 8th, 2025.
** Was the 11th player to reach 4000 assists in the LCK.
* Reached 500 games in the LCK on August 16th, 2025, becoming the 23rd player to do so.
